findings.message: GameHistoryList.tsx's poolsLabel() mislabels a legitimate tone-only round (pools: []) as 'Symbols', because it treats an empty pools array the same as the pre-existing legacy 'pools field predates this entry' case. This phase's own design (task 2.1's AC4, exercised end-to-end by task 2.3's zero-pools-plus-tone test) makes pools: [] a normal, common outcome, not just a legacy artifact, but the file that renders it is outside every task's covers in this phase (and not named anywhere in the plan), so nobody is scoped to fix it.
findings.why_not_fixed: src/presentation/components/molecules/GameHistoryList.tsx is not covered by task 2.3 or any other task in this phase or plan; editing it here would exceed this review's repair scope.
findings.effort_basis: Fixing it correctly needs a way to tell 'legacy-undefined' apart from 'deliberate tone-only' (GameHistoryEntry has no field recording that a round included tone practice at all) plus a render-test proof in GameHistoryList's own suite — and the file is not in any task's `covers` in this plan.

acValidations.locator: src/domain/game/services/ToneGameItemSource.test.ts::AC1: content matches toneSyllablesOf(entry)/entry.thai, even when the card's own syllables field is absent / content ignores a mismatched syllables field on the card itself
acValidations.evidence: Fixture VocabEntry with syllables carrying tones vs. a card with syllables absent (no argument passed) and a second card with a mismatched syllables field; both assert eligibleContent() equals toneSyllablesOf(entry)-derived content, proving content never comes from the card.

acValidations.locator: src/domain/game/services/ToneGameItemSource.test.ts::AC2: a word with no toneIdentification card is excluded from tone eligibility
acValidations.evidence: A card with property 'thaiToEnglish' (no toneIdentification card) yields eligibleContent() === [].

acValidations.locator: src/domain/game/services/ToneGameItemSource.test.ts::AC3: a tone item's audioUrl comes from the matching VocabEntry's thai_audio_file
acValidations.evidence: Asserts eligibleContent()[0].audioUrl equals entry.thai_audio_file; a no-audio-file case asserts audioUrl undefined.

acValidations.locator: src/domain/game/services/GameItemSelectionService.test.ts::AC4: includeTonePractice returns tone items even when 'vocab' is not in pools
acValidations.evidence: Service constructed with sources=[script only] and a separate toneSource; selectRound({pools:['script'], includeTonePractice:true}) returns a tone item, proving the separate-constructor-slot design.

acValidations.locator: src/domain/game/services/GameItemSelectionService.test.ts::AC5: includeTonePractice omitted or false never returns a tone item
acValidations.evidence: Both omitted and explicit-false configs asserted to never include a kind:'tone' item.

acValidations.locator: src/domain/game/services/GameItemSelectionService.test.ts::AC6: every tone item's challengeDirection is the single defined literal
acValidations.evidence: Asserts round deep-equals a tone item with challengeDirection: 'identification', never randomized.

acValidations.locator: src/domain/vocabulary/services/toneSyllables.test.ts::AC7: keeps only syllables with a non-null, non-empty tone, mapped to {text, tone}
acValidations.evidence: Filters out null/empty-tone syllables, keeps determinable ones, matches VocabCardGenerator's inline logic which now calls the same helper (refactor-safety confirmed by shared call site).

acValidations.locator: src/domain/game/services/GameItemSelectionService.test.ts::AC8: prioritizeWeakItems has no effect on tone item selection, even while it genuinely weights vocab
acValidations.evidence: Real cardRepository with heavily-lapsed vs. fresh toneIdentification cards; itemKeyOfCard maps both to 'word:'-prefixed keys (real weights populated) but itemKeyOfContent for tone items uses 'tone:'-prefixed keys (never matched), so both draw near-equally across 200 seeded rounds — a direct proof, not just an absence-of-effect observation.

acValidations.locator: src/application/use-cases/PlayGameUseCase.test.ts::Task 2.2 AC1: a tone item's itemKey is tone:{thaiWord} and does not collide with word item keys
acValidations.evidence: Red-proved (red-proofs/2.2.md AC1): mutating itemKeyOf's tone case to 'word:' causes the not-collide assertion to fail. Green test confirms tone:มา vs word:มา are distinct keys.

acValidations.locator: src/application/use-cases/PlayGameUseCase.test.ts::Task 2.2 AC2: with pools: ['script'] and includeTonePractice: true, tone items still appear even though 'vocab' is not in pools
acValidations.evidence: Red-proved (red-proofs/2.2.md AC2): removing ToneGameItemSource wiring from AppContext.tsx's construction causes the toContain('tone') assertion to fail.

acValidations.locator: src/presentation/components/organisms/ToneIdentificationChallenge.test.tsx::shows the Thai word and plays its audio together on mount... / presents no write-input before or after the reveal
acValidations.evidence: Asserts text+audio together on mount, no textbox/canvas at any point, and per-syllable tone reveal after clicking Show Answer.

acValidations.locator: src/presentation/components/organisms/ToneIdentificationChallenge.test.tsx::constructs no Audio at all for a word with no audioUrl
acValidations.evidence: createdAudioUrls() asserted empty for an item with audioUrl undefined, both before and after reveal.

acValidations.locator: src/presentation/pages/GamePage.test.tsx::leaves the Tone Identification toggle unchecked by default... / includes tone items only when the toggle is checked, alongside the checked pools
acValidations.evidence: Toggle default-unchecked asserted; unchecked round shows only Symbols items over 3 screens, checked round (Symbols still checked) shows both tone and symbol prompts across 7 screens.

acValidations.locator: src/presentation/pages/GamePage.test.tsx::dispatches a tone item to the Tone Identification organism
acValidations.evidence: Fixed-round game with a kind:'tone' item; asserts the tone prompt/text/audio render and reveal shows the syllable's tone.

acValidations.locator: src/presentation/pages/GamePage.test.tsx::leaves the whole thai-srs-state blob byte-identical after a full tone round through the real AppProvider
acValidations.evidence: Seeds thai-srs-state with vocab+toneIdentification cards, plays a full 2-item tone round through the real AppProvider/AppContext wiring to completion, asserts the seeded state string is byte-identical afterward while a separate game-history key was written.

acValidations.locator: src/presentation/pages/GamePage.test.tsx::starts a tone-only round with no pool checked and the toggle checked / explains an empty tone selection in its own words, never the pool-empty message
acValidations.evidence: First case: zero pools + tone checked + tone-eligible words present -> start available, all 4 items are tone-only. Second, separate case: tone checked with zero tone-eligible words -> distinct 'No words with identifiable tones yet' message, not the pool-empty or nothing-eligible text.

acValidations.locator: src/presentation/pages/GamePage.test.tsx::leaves the Tone Identification toggle unchecked by default and keeps it accessibly labeled and keyboard-operable
acValidations.evidence: getByLabelText resolves the toggle (accessible label association via htmlFor/id), .focus() + click toggles checked state.

acValidations.locator: src/presentation/pages/GamePage.test.tsx::counts tone items in the eligible cap when the toggle is checked
acValidations.evidence: 3 eligible symbols + 4 tone-eligible words: cap is 3 unchecked, 7 when Tone Identification is checked, back to 3 when unchecked again — proves includeTonePractice threads into countEligibleItems, not just startRound.

acValidations.locator: src/presentation/pages/GamePage.test.tsx::resets reveal and replays audio across two consecutive tone items sharing one audioUrl (also src/presentation/components/organisms/ToneIdentificationChallenge.test.tsx's own identically-purposed case)
acValidations.evidence: Two fixed tone items sharing one audioUrl; after rating the first, the second renders unrevealed ('Show Answer' button, no leaked tone text) and replays audio a second time — proves reset/replay is keyed on item identity (thaiWord), not audioUrl.
